workshop.title: Text Content
workshop.mission: Create your first FTML page and display a Hello World heading.
instructions: Add the DOCTYPE declaration to the document.
Add the html, head, and body elements.
Add the Front runtime script inside the head.
Add an h1 to the body with settext="Hello World".
workshop.author: Front Academy

workshop.title: Styling
workshop.mission: Use declarative FTML attributes to render and style a message without writing JavaScript.
instructions: Add the DOCTYPE declaration to the document.
Add the html, head, and body elements.
Add the Front runtime script inside the head.
Add an h1 element with settext="Hello from FTML".
Add color="tomato" and bgcolor="white" to the h1 element.
workshop.author: Front Academy

workshop.title: Reactive Variables
workshop.mission: Bind a local variable to page content and connect an input so the value can change reactively.
instructions: Add the DOCTYPE declaration to the document.
Add the html, head, and body elements.
Add the Front runtime script inside the head.
Add setvalue="Front" to the input.
Add an output element with bindfield="name:#nameInput".
Add settext="Hello {name}" to display the bound value.
workshop.author: Front Academy

workshop.title: Events and Visibility
workshop.mission: Use a declarative click event to toggle a panel without writing an event listener.
instructions: Add the DOCTYPE declaration to the document.
Add the html, head, and body elements.
Add the Front runtime script inside the head.
Add a button with a click attribute.
Add toggledisplay to target the panel.
Add the id message to the panel.
Add text inside the panel so its visibility is easy to observe.
Add the solution to Preview and click the button more than once.
workshop.author: Front Academy

workshop.title: Data Rendering
workshop.mission: Fetch JSON data and render a list with data-src, data-iterate, and data-get.
instructions: Add the DOCTYPE declaration to the document.
Add the html, head, and body elements.
Add the Front runtime script inside the head.
Add data-src with the sample JSON.
Add data-iterate="results" to iterate over the collection.
Add a list item for each result.
Add data-get="name" to read each result name.
Add the solution to Preview and confirm that the country names are rendered.
workshop.author: Front Academy
